raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With a pipeline-parallel prefill server in PD disaggregation, every PP stage must release an inflight request at the same step and in the same way. Main does this with a ring consensus over the PP group (#47045 made the concluded outcome agree across stages). #45085 (WIP, @stepinto) replaces the ring with a simpler scheme: PP0 reads every stage's transfer status through `PPConsensusStore` and forwards its decision.

One gap remains in both versions: the *classification* of a failed transfer is still decided locally. When a request is aborted (client `AbortReq` or a decode-side abort), only the rank that saw the abort records an abort reason. A stage that finished its own transfer has no failure reason, so it concludes the same request as a transfer error and returns a 500 for a request the client aborted, while other stages finish it as an abort.

This PR builds on #45085 (its commit is included with authorship preserved; happy to rebase onto it if it lands first) and adds an agreed abort-vs-error classification.

## Modifications

- Commit 1 (from #45085, rebased onto current main): PP0 polls every stage's status via `PPConsensusStore` and forwards the decision, replacing the ring consensus for releasing inflight requests. A transfer that failed on any stage stays Failed (min over stages), which keeps the behavior of #47045. Separate P2P tags for the bootstrap and inflight PP syncs.
- Commit 2:
  - `disaggregation/common/conn.py`: `record_failure` replicates whether a stage's failure was a requested abort to PP0 under a separate key, before the Failed status on the same ordered channel; keys are cleaned up with the room.
  - `disaggregation/utils.py`: `TransferOutcome` and `poll_transfer_outcomes_{prefill_pp,attn_cp_tp_group}`. PP0 forwards polls together with the terminal outcome: an error on any rank outranks an abort on another, and an abort is only reported if every failed rank recorded one. The same classification is applied across attention TP/CP ranks without PP.
  - `disaggregation/prefill.py`: `handle_inflight_transfer_failure` uses the agreed classification (abort → abort finish, error → 500) instead of the local exception.
  - `disaggregation/mooncake/conn.py`: record the decode-side abort reason, as NIXL already does.
- Commit 3: test stub update for the new `request_status` read in `record_failure`.
- Tests: `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_pp_prefill_release_consensus.py` covers PP0 decisions, error-over-abort precedence, abort agreement across stages and TP ranks, and key cleanup.

## Accuracy Tests

Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8, B300, Mooncake over RoCE, mini-LB; prefill `--tp 1 --pp-size 2`, decode `--tp 1`. GSM8K 5-shot greedy, 400 examples:

| | GSM8K |
|---|---|
| main | 0.9625 |
| this PR | 0.960 |

Abort stress on the same deployment: 3 rounds × 96 concurrent requests (ISL 200/2000/6000, OSL 8/128/512), one third cancelled by the client mid-flight, one third aborted through `/abort_request`, one third run to completion. Afterwards 32 normal requests and health checks:

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| hang / stuck stage | no | no |
| completed requests OK | 96/96 | 96/96 |
| post-stress requests OK | 32/32 | 32/32 |
| prefill tracebacks | 0 | 0 |

Both main (44) and this PR (45) return 500 for the `/abort_request` requests whose abort lands while the request is still bootstrapping: decode only learns about it through its waiting timeout. That path is unchanged here (bootstrap-phase abort propagation to decode; related: #47250).

Unit tests: `python -m pytest test/registered/unit/disaggregation/` plus the affected `test/registered/unit/managers/` tests (489 passed).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The PP release path issues one PP0 → stage forward per step instead of a ring pass; the extra abort flag is an int per failed room on the existing channel. No measurable change in GSM8K throughput.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.

Related: #45085, #47045, #47250, #45337.

Hi @garry569,

I think it OK to have prefill node return 500 when receiving abort in some cases.  Could you please talk more on this why 500 is not good?  I'm open to this.

Btw, would you like to help merge #47045 into #45085 first, and make some test on that?

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

+"""PP prefill stages must release each transfer in the same iteration and the same way.
+
+Each PP stage sends the KV of its own layers, so its sender can conclude a
+transfer at a different time, or with a different result, than the other
+stages. PP0 decides from every stage's status in PPConsensusStore and forwards
+the decision; every stage applies it instead of its own local poll.
+"""

+class _PPGroup:
+    """In-process stand-in for the PP CPU group shared by both stages."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._broadcast = None
+        self._inflight = deque()
+        self.sends = 0
+
+    def broadcast_object(self, obj, src=0):
+        if obj is not None:
+            self._broadcast = obj
+        return self._broadcast
+
+    def send_object(self, obj, dst, async_send=False, tag=0):
+        self.sends += 1
+        self._inflight.append(obj)
+        return []
+
+    def recv_object(self, src, tag=0):
+        return self._inflight.popleft()

+class _Sender:
+    """Reads the stage's real store the way CommonKVSender does."""
+
+    def __init__(self, kv_mgr, room):
+        self.kv_mgr = kv_mgr
+        self.bootstrap_room = room
+        self.local_polls = 0
+
+    def poll(self):
+        self.local_polls += 1
+        return self.kv_mgr.request_status[self.bootstrap_room]
+
+    def poll_pp_consensus(self):
+        return CommonKVManager.check_status_pp_consensus(
+            self.kv_mgr, self.bootstrap_room
+        )
+
+    def is_failure_requested_abort(self):
+        return utils.is_abort_failure_reason(
+            self.kv_mgr.failure_records.get(self.bootstrap_room)
+        )
+
+    def is_failure_requested_abort_pp_consensus(self):
+        return CommonKVManager.is_failure_requested_abort_pp_consensus(
+            self.kv_mgr, self.bootstrap_room
+        )
+
+    def clear(self):
+        pass
+
+    def failure_exception(self):

+    """One prefill PP stage running the real inflight-queue release path."""

+    _release_aborted_request = Scheduler._release_aborted_request

+    def __init__(self, pp_rank, pp_group):

+            request_status=self.store,

+        self.metrics_collector = Mock()

+        self.output_streamer = SimpleNamespace(
+            stream_output=lambda reqs, *args: self.streamed.extend(

+    def release(self):

+        with get_parallel().override(pp_rank=self.pp_rank, pp_size=2, tp_rank=0):

+    def inflight(self, rid, room, status=KVPoll.Transferring):

+            time_stats=SimpleNamespace(
+                set_prefill_kv_transfer_finish_time=lambda: None,
+                set_completion_time=lambda: None,
+                trace_ctx=SimpleNamespace(abort=lambda **kw: None),
+            ),
+            release_mm_inputs_on_abort=lambda: None,
+        )
+        req.finish_outside_step = lambda reason: setattr(req, "finished_reason", reason)
+        self.disagg_prefill_inflight_queue.append(req)
+        return req
+
+    def fail(self, room, reason):
+        """Fail a room the way a backend does: record the reason, then mark Failed."""
+        CommonKVManager.record_failure(self.kv_mgr, room, reason)
+        self.store[room] = KVPoll.Failed
+

+def _classify(req, message, status_code=None):
+    # A real transfer error carries a 500; a requested abort carries none.
+    req.finished_reason = (
+        "error" if status_code == HTTPStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR else "abort"
+    )

+    def test_failure_on_one_stage_carries_its_classification_everywhere(self):

+                self.pp1.fail(room, reason)

+                self._iterate()

-"""PP consensus on the outcome of PD prefill KV transfers.
-
-Each PP stage of a disaggregated prefill sends the KV of its own layers. A
-client abort that lands after the first stage finished sending fails only the
-later stages, so the stages must agree not only on which transfers concluded
-but also on whether each one failed.
-"""
-
-import unittest
-from types import SimpleNamespace
-
-from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_pp_mixin import SchedulerPPMixin
-from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci

-
-register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
-
-
-def _stage(first_rank: bool, succeeded, failed, prev=None):
-    """A PP stage whose own senders report `succeeded` / `failed` rids."""
-    return SimpleNamespace(
-        pp_group=SimpleNamespace(is_first_rank=first_rank),
-        disagg_prefill_inflight_queue=[],
-        get_rids=lambda queue, is_send, *groups: (list(succeeded), list(failed)),
-        _pp_recv_pyobj_from_prev_stage=lambda: prev,
-    )
-
-
-def _consensus(stage):
-    return SchedulerPPMixin._pp_pd_get_prefill_transferred_ids(stage)
-
-
-class TestPPPrefillTransferOutcomeConsensus(CustomTestCase):
-    def test_first_stage_reports_its_own_outcomes(self):
-        stage = _stage(first_rank=True, succeeded=["a"], failed=["b"])
-        self.assertEqual(_consensus(stage), {"a": False, "b": True})
-

-            succeeded=["c"],
-            failed=["r"],
-            prev={"r": False, "c": False},
-        )

-        # The failure is carried on even where this stage itself succeeded.
-        stage2 = _stage(first_rank=False, succeeded=["r"], failed=[], prev={"r": True})
